senses.gloss:
वेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be woven.
—वेय-गान, अम्,
n. a particular song-book or manual of singing giving
(with the Āraṇya-gāna) the various modifications of
intonation for the Ārcika division of the Sāma-veda,
(the Staubhika division also has two of these song-
books, viz. the Ūha-g˚ and Ūhya-g˚.)
—वेय-च्छला,
f., Ved., N. of a chapter of the Sāmaveda-cchalā, q. v.
